section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section details the findings of the present study, which examined the associations between nature exposure, connectedness to nature, and body appreciation in U.S. adult women and men. The study replicated previous work by showing a positive association between connectedness to nature and body appreciation, and extended this to include nature exposure. It also identified mediation pathways, with self-esteem mediating relationships for both genders, and motivational salience of appearance and internalization of a muscular ideal mediating for men only. The study utilized the BAS-2 for body appreciation assessment and employed an online recruitment method for its U.S. adult sample.
